This could be environment-dependent, like a LOG_LEVEL variable or similar config that's missing or set incorrectly, causing the wrong logger type to be instantiated. The service might work fine with the proper environment configuration, so I need to examine the bizlog_wrapper and diagnostics code to see what's driving this logger selection.
